web.stack_hint: HAProxy routes ports 80/443 (IPv4 + IPv6) by SNI; Nginx and each PHP-FPM version run as Docker containers. Configs are generated from the database.
web.no_docker: Docker is not available. Re-run the install command (it installs Docker).
web.not_installed: The web stack is not installed yet; it is installed with your first site (uses ports 80 / 443).
web.cf_token_hint: Permissions: Zone → DNS → Edit and Zone → Zone → Read. Stored encrypted and never shown again.
web.acme_directory_hint: From your LiteSSL / CA dashboard, together with the EAB key ID and HMAC key.
web.tos: Requesting a certificate accepts the selected CA's terms of service.

site.php_switch_hint: Takes effect immediately; a version used for the first time takes a few minutes to build.
site.dns_hint: Creates A (IPv4) and AAAA (IPv6) records pointing to this server
site.need_cf: Set a Cloudflare API token under Web stack first
site.ssl_http_hint: The domain must already point to this server (port 80 reachable)
site.ssl_dns_hint: Validated via Cloudflare TXT records; supports wildcards
site.ssl_disable_confirm: Remove this site's certificate and turn off Force HTTPS?
site.cf_hint_title: The domain is proxied by Cloudflare (orange cloud)
site.cf_hint_dns: Use DNS-01 (Cloudflare) instead, which is not affected by the proxy; or temporarily set Cloudflare SSL/TLS mode to Full (not strict) and switch back to Full (strict) once issued.
site.cf_hint_token: Cloudflare rejects the origin until it has a valid certificate (526 in Full (strict) mode). Easiest: add a Cloudflare API token under Web stack and request with DNS-01; or temporarily set SSL/TLS mode to Full (not strict).
site.need_runtime: Install this runtime from the App Store first.
site.app_port_hint: The app listens on 127.0.0.1:PORT (env PORT / HOST)
site.command_hint: Runs in the project directory with sh -c; empty = default for the runtime
site.proxy_target_hint: http(s)://host:port, e.g. a Docker container on 127.0.0.1
site.passthrough: TLS passthrough (the backend holds the certificate)
site.passthrough_hint: host:port of a TLS backend; HTTP redirects to HTTPS
site.composer_hint: Runs Composer in the site's PHP container as www-data, in the site root.

app.remove_data: Also delete its data and image
app.name: App
app.config_hint: Saving restarts the service; if it does not come back, the previous file is restored.
app.loopback_hint: Listens on loopback only. Websites and projects on this server connect to this address.

desc.phpmyadmin: Web MySQL / MariaDB manager inside the panel, signed in automatically

db.delete_confirm: Drop database {name} and its user? Data cannot be recovered.
db.name: Database
db.no_engine: No database engine is installed yet.
db.name_hint: Letters, digits and _, starting with a letter (max 32)
db.pma_hint: Install phpMyAdmin from the App Store to manage MySQL / MariaDB databases in the browser.

docker.name: Name
docker.ports_hint: One per line: [IP:]host:container[/udp]. Use 127.0.0.1: and bind a domain to publish through HTTPS.
docker.project_delete_confirm: Stop project {name} and delete its files?
docker.prune_volumes: Remove volumes not used by any container?
docker.prune_networks: Remove networks not used by any container?

files.name: Name
files.delete_confirm: Move {n} item(s) to the recycle bin?
files.cross_device_confirm: The recycle bin is on another disk. Delete permanently instead?
files.resume_confirm: {name} was partly uploaded. Resume? (Cancel uploads it again)
files.empty_trash_confirm: Permanently delete everything in the recycle bin?

term.verify: Re-enter your panel password to open a root shell on this server.
term.verify_container: Re-enter your panel password to open a shell in {name}.

route.intro: Every hostname on ports 443/80 and where it goes. A hostname belongs to exactly one website, Docker binding or proxy; exact names win over wildcards, and a deeper wildcard over a shallower one.
route.warned: {n} hostname(s) need attention — hover the tags in the Checks column.

kind_hint.alias: Adds the hostname (e.g. a subdomain) to an existing site; request a certificate that covers it afterwards.
kind_hint.site: Creates a PHP, static, Node.js, Python or Java website for this hostname.
kind_hint.docker: Proxies HTTP to a port a container publishes on this server; HTTPS ends at the edge.
kind_hint.server: Reverse-proxies to another server or service: http(s)://host:port.
kind_hint.passthrough: Forwards the raw TLS stream by SNI to host:port; the backend holds the certificate.

match.default: No route for {host}: it gets the default certificate and nginx's default page.

no_cert.long: No valid certificate covers this hostname, so browsers see the default certificate. Request one under the site's SSL (wildcards need DNS-01).

cf_passthrough.long: Cloudflare's proxy (orange cloud) ends TLS itself, so the backend must present a certificate Cloudflare accepts; consider DNS only (grey cloud).

upstream_down.long: Nothing answers at the target address; the container or service may be stopped.

dns_none.long: The hostname does not resolve yet.

dns_elsewhere.long: The hostname resolves to an address that is not this server's public IP.

wildcard_overridden.long: These hostnames inside the wildcard belong to other sites: {hosts}

maint.update_desc: Download and install {to} (now {from}) from GitHub. The panel restarts for a moment.
maint.repair_desc: Reinstall the current version: program files, the systemd service and Docker are checked and rebuilt.
maint.kept: Kept: website files (/www), databases and app data, certificates, firewall rules, panel settings and accounts.
maint.rebuild: Also recreate the web stack containers (HAProxy, nginx, PHP-FPM) from the saved configuration
maint.wait: Running… the panel restarts during this, the log continues afterwards.
maint.failed: Failed (exit {code}); the installer rolled back to the previous version. See the log.

geo.downloading: Downloading the IP database in the background…

cron.name: Name
cron.script_hint: Output and exit status are kept for each run; a run still going is skipped instead of starting twice.
cron.logrotate_hint: Gzips every website log in /www/wwwlogs and tells nginx to reopen them.

fw.title: Server firewall (nftables)
fw.enable_hint: Its own nftables table (inet lmcwhm); ufw and Docker rules are left alone. Rescue over SSH: lmcwhm firewall-off

policy_hint.accept: Everything is reachable except what rules and the block list deny.
policy_hint.drop: Only protected ports and allow rules are reachable. Applied with a 60 s safety check.

fw.protect_hint: Always allow TCP {ports} (SSH, panel, web) before any rule.
fw.drop_unprotected: Deny with unprotected ports can lock you out; keep an allow rule for SSH and the panel port.
fw.confirming: Checking that the panel is still reachable through the new rules… reverts in {n} s if not.
fw.confirmed: The panel is reachable: new rules kept.
fw.confirm_failed: Could not reach the panel through the new rules: they are rolled back to Allow within {n} seconds.
fw.rules_hint: Evaluated in order after the block list. Allow rules matter with the Deny default; deny rules close a port with the Allow default.
fw.source_hint: Empty = anywhere; or an IP / CIDR (v4 or v6)
fw.live: Live ruleset (nft list table inet lmcwhm)
fw.no_nft: nftables (nft) is not installed: run install.sh again or apt install nftables.
fw.lists_hint: Allowed addresses skip every rule; blocked ones are dropped for all ports, also for Docker-published ports. Your own address cannot be blocked.
fw.lists_inactive: The firewall is off: lists are saved but not enforced on this server.
fw.sync_hint: Permanent blocks are pushed to the edges enabled under Linode / Cloudflare (automatically after changes). Temporary bans stay on the server.
fw.linode_intro: A Linode Cloud Firewall filters traffic before it reaches this server. Create a personal access token with Firewalls: Read/Write and Linodes: Read/Write.
fw.token_saved: Token saved (enter a new one to replace)
fw.linode_sync: Push the block list (a DROP rule labelled lmcwhm-block, first in order)
fw.linode_ports: Keep an ACCEPT rule for protected ports {ports} (lmcwhm-ports)
fw.linode_rules: {n} inbound rules, inbound default {policy}. Rules lmcwhm did not create are never changed.
fw.cf_no_token: Add a Cloudflare API token under Websites → Web stack to use Cloudflare.
fw.cf_sync: Push the block list to every zone as IP Access Rules (notes "lmcwhm")
fw.cf_hint: Cloudflare accepts single addresses, IPv4 /16 and /24 and IPv6 /32, /48 and /64. The token needs Zone → Firewall Services: Edit.

waf.title: Web application firewall
waf.enable_hint: ModSecurity v3 + OWASP Core Rule Set in nginx ({image}).
waf.anomaly_hint: Score at which a request is blocked (CRS default 5; higher = more permissive).
waf.sites_off: Turn the WAF on above for these settings to take effect.

cs.intro: CrowdSec reads website and SSH logs, detects attacks (brute force, scans, CVE probes) and issues bans, which the panel enforces in its firewall.
cs.community: Join the community: share signals and receive the community blocklist
cs.uninstall_confirm: Remove CrowdSec and lift its bans?
cs.fw_off: The firewall is off: CrowdSec bans are recorded but not enforced. Enable it under Firewall.

bk.delete_confirm: Delete this backup (also on the cloud storage)?
bk.keep_hint: Newest copies kept per target and location; 0 keeps all.
bk.exclude_hint: File or folder name patterns, e.g. node_modules, *.log, cache
bk.plan_name_hint: Optional; defaults to the type and target
bk.cron_hint: Backup plan as JSON; easier to edit on the Backups page.

restore_warn.site: The files of {target} will be replaced by this backup. The current files are swapped out only after the archive unpacked completely.
restore_warn.database: The database will be overwritten with the dump. Writes made since the backup are lost.
restore_warn.volume: Everything in volume {target} is deleted and replaced. Stop the containers that use it first.
restore_warn.path: Directory {target} will be replaced by this backup.

bk.import_hint: Upload the archive with the file manager first (e.g. from another server), then register it here so it can be restored.
bk.remote_intro: Backups can be uploaded to Google Drive or OneDrive. You register your own OAuth app, then approve the panel with a one-time code; no callback URL to the panel is needed.

howto.gdrive: Google Cloud Console → APIs and Services: enable the Google Drive API, then Credentials → Create OAuth client ID → type “TVs and Limited Input devices”. Paste its client ID and secret here. The panel only sees files it created (drive.file scope).
howto.onedrive: Azure portal → App registrations → New registration (personal and/or work accounts). Under Authentication enable “Allow public client flows”. Paste the Application (client) ID here. Files go to the app folder Apps/<app name>.

bk.remote_delete_confirm: Remove this storage? Its backups stay in the cloud but disappear from the list.
bk.authorize_step1: 1. Open this page and sign in:
bk.authorize_wait: This window closes by itself once you approve.
bk.auth_expired: The code expired or was declined; try again.

alert.name: Name
alert.tg_hint: Create a bot with BotFather; send it a message, then use your chat ID.
alert.webhook_hint: Receives a JSON POST with title, body, severity, kind, host and time.
alert.cooldown_hint: While the problem lasts, notify again after this long. A notice is also sent when it is resolved.

rule_desc.service_down: A panel container (web stack, database, project) is not running
rule_desc.ssl_expiry: A site certificate expires within {days} days
rule_desc.probe_down: An uptime check goes down (and back up)
rule_desc.cron_failed: A cron or backup job fails or times out
rule_desc.login_failed: {count} or more failed panel logins within {minutes} min

probe.alert_hint: Add an “Uptime check failed” alert rule to be notified.
probe.name: Name
probe.keyword_hint: Optional text that must appear in the response

proc.intro: Runs as a systemd service: restarted when it exits, started at boot; output goes to the journal.
proc.name: Name
proc.name_hint: Lowercase letters, digits, - and _; the service is lmcwhm-proc-<name>.
proc.command_hint: A bash script; keep the main program in the foreground (use exec).

ftp.username_hint: 3–32 lowercase letters, digits, - or _; for SFTP this becomes a system account.
ftp.sftp_hint: SFTP uses sshd: users are chrooted to their directory and cannot log in to a shell.
ftp.ftp_off: FTP is off: turn it on above, or the account is only saved.

ai.no_key: Add an Anthropic API key to use the assistant.
ai.intro: Ask about this server. The assistant reads logs, metrics and settings through read-only tools and tells you what to do; it does not change anything.
ai.placeholder: e.g. Why is example.com returning 502? (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)

security.label: Security triage
security.prompt: Do a security triage of this server: firewall, SSH and panel logins, WAF and CrowdSec events, suspicious requests. Rank the risks and tell me what to fix.

load.label: Why is it slow?
load.prompt: Investigate CPU, memory, disk and network usage over the last 24 hours and tell me what is causing load.

backups.label: Check backups
backups.prompt: Review backup coverage: which sites and databases have no recent or off-site backup, and which backup jobs fail?

errors.label: Find website errors
errors.prompt: Check every website for 5xx errors, error log entries and stopped containers, and explain the causes.

ai.prompt_ssh: Analyse the recent SSH logins: brute-force sources, unusual successful logins, and whether I should block anything.
ai.prompt_site_access: Analyse the access log of {domain}: traffic, errors, top clients and suspicious requests.
ai.prompt_site_error: Read the error log of {domain} and explain each problem and its fix.
ai.prompt_site_traffic: Summarise the traffic of {domain} and point out anything unusual (bots, attacks, error spikes).
ai.prompt_waf: Review the recent WAF events: which are real attacks and which look like false positives? Propose rule exclusions per site.
ai.connect_ssh: Over SSH (no token, uses your SSH login; recommended):
ai.connect_http: Over HTTPS with an API token (the panel port must be reachable; a self-signed certificate must be trusted by the client):

scope_hint.read: Read logs, metrics and settings only.
scope_hint.operate: Also restart containers, block IPs, run cron jobs and backups, issue certificates.
scope_hint.admin: Also run any shell command as root. Give it only to clients you fully trust.

ai.ips_hint: Empty = any IP (the panel's own IP restriction still applies)
ai.revoke_confirm: Revoke this token? Clients using it stop working.
ai.token_once: Copy it now: it is shown only once.
ai.api_key_hint: From console.anthropic.com; stored encrypted. Usage is billed to your account.
ai.model_hint: Default {model}; a Sonnet or Haiku model costs less.
ai.effort_hint: Higher is more thorough but slower and costs more.
ai.base_url_hint: Only for a gateway in front of the Anthropic API.

risks.no_entry: No security entry: the login page is reachable by anyone who finds the port.
risks.default_port: The panel uses the default port 8888.
risks.panel_http: Panel SSL is off: logins travel unencrypted.
risks.panel_open: No authorised IPs or BasicAuth in front of the panel.
risks.no_2fa: Two-factor authentication is off for the admin.
risks.no_recent_backup: No backup in the last 7 days.
risks.no_alert_channel: No alert channel: you will not be notified of problems.
risks.cron_failed: {n} cron job(s) failed on their last run.

adv.title: Advanced
adv.allow_ips_hint: When set, every other IP gets 403. IPs or CIDRs.
adv.deny_ua_hint: Case-insensitive parts of the User-Agent, e.g. MJ12bot, python-requests
adv.hotlink_hint: Domains allowed to embed images and media; empty = off. Your own domains are always allowed.
adv.rate_hint: 0 = no limit; over the limit returns 429.
adv.error_pages: Custom error pages (/404.html, /50x.html in the site root)

stats.title: Traffic
stats.spiders_excluded: {n} crawler requests are counted in PV but not in UV or the top lists.

wp.install_intro: Install WordPress into this site: a MySQL / MariaDB database is created, wp-config.php is written and the admin user is set up with WP-CLI.
wp.need_mysql: Install MySQL or MariaDB from the App Store first.
wp.no_file_edit: Disable the dashboard plugin / theme editor (DISALLOW_FILE_EDIT)
